items.text: ClockBase Agent preprint is out! We developed AI agents that autonomously discover aging interventions from millions of molecular profiles, identifying 500+ compounds that reduce biological age.

Our new paper in Nature Aging is published! With the Biomarkers of Aging Consortium, we present Biolearn, an open-source framework unifying 39 aging biomarkers across 20,000+ individuals from multiple cohorts.
Officially Dr. Ying! I successfully defended my Ph.D. at Harvard.
We are featured as semifinalist of Harvard President's Innovation Challenge, Health Care and Life Sciences Track.

Excited to join Tony Wyss-Coray lab at Stanford University & Baker lab at Institute for Protein Design, University of Washington as F99K00 Postdoc fellow! Merging aging biology + protein design to tackle neurodegeneration. 🧬
MethylGPT is featured in Eric Topol's opinion piece in Science Magazine!
